itinerary.title: Arrival in Paradise • Tropical Warmth in Negombo
itinerary.description: Arrive at Bandaranaike International Airport where your private Lotus Ceylon chauffeur guide warmly welcomes you with fresh lotus blooms. Transfer to your seaside boutique hotel in Negombo to unwind by the pool and enjoy your first authentic coastal sunset.

itinerary.title: Scenic Southern Highway • Tangalle’s Secluded Bays
itinerary.description: Journey south along the scenic expressway towards Tangalle, famed for its untouched golden beaches and whispering palms. Check into your luxury oceanfront pavilion. Afternoon at leisure listening to the rhythm of the Indian Ocean.

itinerary.title: Hummanaya Natural Geyser & Mulgirigala Monastic Rock
itinerary.description: Witness the dramatic Hummanaya natural sea blowhole sending spray 30 meters skyward. Later, explore the tranquil 2,000-year-old Mulgirigala rock monastery tucked into lush coconut forests.

itinerary.title: Coastal Drive to Mirissa • Sunset at Coconut Tree Hill
itinerary.description: Drive west along the picturesque coastline to Mirissa. In the late afternoon, take a gentle walk up Coconut Tree Hill for an iconic panoramic view of the turquoise bay framed by slender palms.

itinerary.title: Gentle Ocean Giants • Blue Whale Marine Safari
itinerary.description: Board a private chartered boat at sunrise into the deep oceanic trench off Mirissa. Accompanied by our marine naturalist, encounter the world's largest mammal—the magnificent blue whale—along with pods of playful spinner dolphins.

itinerary.title: Unawatuna Bay & Living Heritage of UNESCO Galle Fort
itinerary.description: Travel to historic Galle. In the afternoon, embark on an insider's walking tour of the 17th-century Dutch Fort with a local heritage historian, strolling cobblestone alleys lined with artisan jewelers, colonial mansions, and bastions overlooking the ocean.

itinerary.title: Stilt Fishermen of Koggala & Coastal Artisan Ateliers
itinerary.description: Witness the timeless practice of stilt fishermen balancing skillfully above the coastal breakers at Koggala. Visit an intimate cinnamon peeling plantation and traditional lace-weaving ateliers.

itinerary.title: Bentota Coastal Sanctuary • Madu River Boat Safari
itinerary.description: Head northward to Bentota's golden ribbon of beach. Enjoy a peaceful motorized boat cruise along the mangrove canopies of the Madu River wetland, visiting a quiet cinnamon island and bird sanctuaries.

itinerary.title: Kosgoda Sea Turtle Sanctuary & Beachfront Leisure
itinerary.description: Visit the renowned Kosgoda Sea Turtle Conservation Project to learn about protecting endangered sea turtles. Spend your final coastal evening with a private candlelit seafood dinner served under the palms right beside the waves.

itinerary.title: Colombo Heritage Drive • Farewell to Ceylon
itinerary.description: Enjoy a leisurely morning swim followed by a scenic transfer to Colombo for light shopping and colonial sightseeing before arriving at the airport for your onward journey with unforgettable memories.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Negombo • Gateway to Ceylon
itinerary.description: Touch down in Sri Lanka and transfer to a serene seaside retreat in Negombo. Rest and prepare for your trans-island expedition toward the sunrise coasts.

itinerary.title: Cross-Island Journey to Trincomalee
itinerary.description: Drive across the lush central dry plains toward the historic naval harbor city of Trincomalee on the northeast coast. Arrive at Nilaveli Beach where powdery white sands meet turquoise waters.

itinerary.title: Pigeon Island Marine Sanctuary Snorkeling Expedition
itinerary.description: Take a short speedboat ride to Pigeon Island National Park. Put on your snorkel to marvel at vibrant staghorn corals, sea turtles, and docile reef sharks swimming in crystalline warm water.

itinerary.title: Koneswaram Cliff Temple & Fort Frederick
itinerary.description: Visit historic Fort Frederick and the sacred Koneswaram Kovil perched high on Swami Rock, revered as the 'Temple of a Thousand Pillars' with dizzying ocean drop-offs.

itinerary.title: Coastal Route to the Shallows of Pasikudah
itinerary.description: Follow the eastern coastline south to Pasikudah, renowned for having one of the longest shallow coastline stretches in the world, sheltered by a natural reef barrier.

itinerary.title: Barefoot Lagoon Relaxation & Water Sports
itinerary.description: Spend a peaceful day swimming in calm glass-like waters, paddle-boarding, or indulging in signature coconut oil Ayurvedic massages by the sea.

itinerary.title: Journey to Arugam Bay • The Surfing Capital
itinerary.description: Travel southward along scenic rural roads to Arugam Bay, consistently ranked among the world's top ten surf destinations, surrounded by wild lagoons and peaceful village life.

itinerary.title: Dawn Waves & Elephant Lagoon Safari at Pottuvil
itinerary.description: Catch early morning waves at Main Point or Baby Point with a licensed instructor. In the late afternoon, embark on an authentic lagoon canoe safari through Pottuvil Lagoon to spot wild elephants bathing on the banks.

itinerary.title: Kudumbigala Forest Hermitage & Panama Dunes
itinerary.description: Visit the ancient rock monastery of Kudumbigala rising high above the jungle canopy, followed by an evening walk along the dramatic, windswept sand dunes of Panama.

itinerary.title: Highland Foothills Transit toward Central Country
itinerary.description: Begin the return journey with a scenic inland drive through the foothills of the central highlands, enjoying majestic waterfall views and cool mountain breezes.

itinerary.title: Colonial Colombo Cosmopolitan Evening
itinerary.description: Descend to vibrant Colombo. Enjoy an evening walk through the historic Old Dutch Hospital precinct and sunset drinks overlooking Galle Face Green.

itinerary.title: Farewell to Sri Lanka • Airport Departure
itinerary.description: Following breakfast and final souvenir shopping for premium Ceylon tea and handcrafted treasures, transfer comfortably to the airport for your flight home.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Colombo • Coastal Highway to Kalpitiya
itinerary.description: Meet your private chauffeur guide at the airport and head north to the wild, windswept peninsula of Kalpitiya, bounded by the sea and a tranquil lagoon.

itinerary.title: Kalpitiya Dolphin Pod Cruise & Coral Bar
itinerary.description: Embark at sunrise on a thrilling ocean cruise. Watch in awe as hundreds of acrobatic spinner dolphins leap beside your boat across pristine waters.

itinerary.title: Historic Mannar Island • Ancient Baobab Trees
itinerary.description: Journey north into the fascinating landscape of Mannar. Marvel at ancient baobab trees planted by Arab seafaring traders centuries ago and explore Dutch colonial ramparts.

itinerary.title: Adam’s Bridge Mythical Sandbanks
itinerary.description: Drive out to the western tip of Mannar Island to view the mythical limestone shoals of Rama Sethu (Adam’s Bridge) connecting Sri Lanka toward India.

itinerary.title: Crossing into Northern Jaffna Peninsula
itinerary.description: Cross the historic Elephant Pass causeway into the vibrant cultural landscape of Jaffna. Check into your heritage boutique hotel and enjoy authentic northern crab curry.

itinerary.title: Casuarina Beach & Sacred Keerimalai Natural Springs
itinerary.description: Unwind on the silky soft white sands of Casuarina Beach on Karainagar Island, followed by a visit to the natural mineral water springs of Keerimalai by the ocean.

itinerary.title: Nagadeepa Island Temple Boat Crossing
itinerary.description: Take a short ferry ride to sacred Nagadeepa Island, visited by the Buddha, and admire the vibrant, soaring gopurams of the ancient Nagapooshani Amman Kovil.

itinerary.title: Coast-to-Coast Drive to Trincomalee
itinerary.description: Travel across to the tranquil eastern shores of Trincomalee. Unpack at a private beachfront villa on Nilaveli Beach.

itinerary.title: Snorkeling Pigeon Island Coral Sanctuaries
itinerary.description: Spend the morning snorkeling above protected marine reefs teeming with tropical sea life, followed by a relaxed afternoon sipping fresh coconuts.

itinerary.title: Pasikudah Bay • The Infinite Shallow Horizon
itinerary.description: Head south to Pasikudah's tranquil bay. Enjoy barefoot strolls along the calm shoreline and dip in the warm, wave-free sea.

itinerary.title: Pure Beachfront Serenity in Pasikudah
itinerary.description: A full day dedicated to rejuvenation. Enjoy personalized wellness spa therapies, fresh seafood dinners, and undisturbed ocean views.

itinerary.title: Inland Cultural Transition to Sigiriya Foothills
itinerary.description: Drive inland toward the majestic cultural triangle for an overnight stay in an eco-luxury pavilion overlooking ancient reservoir lakes.

itinerary.title: Negombo Farewell Evening
itinerary.description: Return westward to Negombo for a celebratory farewell dinner beside the ocean with your private chauffeur guide.

itinerary.title: Departure from Paradise
itinerary.description: Transfer to the international airport for your homeward flight, carrying the peace and purity of Ceylon's untamed coastlines.

itinerary.title: Dambulla Cave Frescoes & Habarana Sanctuary
itinerary.description: Drive into the Cultural Triangle. Ascend the gentle granite slopes of Dambulla to explore five sacred cave shrines filled with masterfully painted Buddhist frescoes. Continue to your forest boutique resort.

itinerary.title: Sigiriya 5th-Century Sky Fortress & Village Immersion
itinerary.description: At dawn, climb King Kasyapa's 5th-century Sigiriya Rock Fortress before the morning sun warms the stone. Pass the famous Cloud Maidens frescoes and the colossal Lion's Paw terrace. In the afternoon, enjoy an authentic wooden catamaran ride and clay-pot lunch in rural Hiriwadunna.

itinerary.title: Spice Gardens of Matale & Highland Royal Capital of Kandy
itinerary.description: Travel southward into the mist-draped hills of Kandy, stopping at an organic herbal spice garden in Matale. In Kandy, check into your boutique hotel overlooking the royal lake. At sunset, attend the resonant evening drumming puja inside the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic.

itinerary.title: Peradeniya Royal Botanical Gardens & Colombo
itinerary.description: Stroll beneath towering Royal Palms and giant Java Fig trees in Peradeniya Botanical Gardens, once reserved exclusively for Kandyan royalty. Drive down to Colombo for colonial sightseeing and an exquisite farewell dinner.

itinerary.title: Farewell to Ceylon • Airport Transfer

itinerary.title: Pilgrimage to First Royal Capital: Anuradhapura
itinerary.description: Drive northward to Anuradhapura, Ceylon's sacred capital for over a millennium. Pay homage to the sacred Jaya Sri Maha Bodhi and stand in awe beneath the towering white dome of Ruwanwelisaya Stupa.

itinerary.title: Monastic Sanctuaries & Mihintale Cradle of Buddhism
itinerary.description: Explore the peaceful monastic ruins of Jetavanarama and the serene stone guardstones of Ratnaprasada. In the afternoon, climb the rock stairway of Mihintale, revered as the sacred birthplace of Buddhism in Sri Lanka.

itinerary.title: Mystic Ritigala Forest Hermitage & Sigiriya
itinerary.description: Journey south through dense forests to the enigmatic ruins of Ritigala Strict Nature Reserve, where ancient monastic walking paths wind past silent meditation platforms. Continue to your luxury resort overlooking Sigiriya.

itinerary.title: Sigiriya Dawn Fortress Ascent & Village Catamaran Safari
itinerary.description: Ascend Sigiriya Rock Fortress at sunrise, admiring the mirror wall and dramatic cloud maidens frescoes. Afternoon at leisure followed by an authentic village catamaran ride and rural dining.

itinerary.title: Medieval Splendor of Polonnaruwa by Bicycle
itinerary.description: Cycle along tree-lined shaded avenues through the 12th-century medieval capital of Polonnaruwa. Gaze at the masterfully carved granite Buddha statues of Gal Vihara and the Royal Palace of King Parakramabahu.

itinerary.title: Dambulla Golden Caves to Royal Mountain Capital Kandy
itinerary.description: Explore Dambulla's cave temple sanctuaries before winding into the misty hills of Kandy. In the evening, observe sacred drumming rituals during the public veneration at the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic.

itinerary.title: Peradeniya Royal Gardens & Scenic Transit to Colombo
itinerary.description: Stroll through the world-renowned Peradeniya Botanical Gardens with its famed orchid pavilion. Transfer to Colombo for an evening heritage driving tour and fine dining.

itinerary.title: Farewell to Sacred Ceylon
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast, last-minute artisanal shopping, and a comfortable private transfer to the international airport for your flight home.

itinerary.title: Wilpattu National Park • Natural Villus & Sloth Bears
itinerary.description: Drive northward to Wilpattu, Sri Lanka’s largest and oldest national park. Board a custom 4x4 safari jeep for an afternoon game drive tracking sloth bears, leopards, and barking deer around natural rainwater basins (villus).

itinerary.title: Dawn Game Drive & Transit to the Elephant Heartlands
itinerary.description: Set off on a misty dawn game drive in Wilpattu when predators are most active. Later, journey to Habarana, the heart of the wild elephant corridor.

itinerary.title: The Great Minneriya Elephant Gathering Safari

itinerary.title: Highland Edge Transit toward Yala National Park
